question: 特斯拉最新的市盈率是多少？
answer:
[1] 关键金融指标：市盈率（PE，Price-to-Earnings Ratio）

[2] 可能的计算公式：  
市盈率 = 当前股价 / 每股收益（EPS）  
即：PE = Price per Share / Earnings per Share

生成查询代码
SELECT 
    asm.CSNAME AS `股票名称`,
    asm.COMB_SYMBOL AS `股票代码`,
    asm.FIU_ID AS `美股内部代码`,
    com.F021N AS `最新市盈率`,
    ROUND(com.F021N, 2) AS `最新市盈率(保留2位小数)`,
    com.F022D AS `市盈率更新时间`,
    com.F002V AS `市盈率货币`
FROM 
    AMERICAN_STOCK_MAIN asm
LEFT JOIN 
    COM3101 com
    ON asm.FIU_ID = com.FIU_ID
WHERE 
    asm.COMB_SYMBOL = 'TSLA.US'
    AND com.F021N IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY 
    com.F022D DESC
LIMIT 1
